```{python}
#| label: fig-cmos-cross-section
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "NMOS and PMOS transistors integrated on a single wafer: the NMOS sits directly in the p-substrate, the PMOS in a local n-well. The p$^+$ substrate contact ties the substrate to $V_\\mathrm{SS}$, the n$^+$ well contact ties the n-well to $V_\\mathrm{DD}$."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', nwell='#aacdea', ox='#c7dff2', poly='#c46262',
         nplus='#4a7fb5', pplus='#d1862c', metal='#a0a0a0')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 3.2))
SURF = 3.0

# substrate and n-well
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 14, SURF, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((7.2, 1.2), 6.4, SURF - 1.2, fc=C['nwell'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(3.5, 0.4, 'p-substrate', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.text(10.4, 1.5, 'n-well', ha='center', fontsize=9)


def diff(x0, w, typ):
    fc = C['nplus'] if typ == 'n' else C['pplus']
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF - 0.5), w, 0.5, fc=fc, ec='k', lw=0.6))
    ax.text(x0 + w / 2, SURF - 0.25, f'${typ}^+$', ha='center',
            va='center', fontsize=8, color='white')


def gate(x0, w):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF), w, 0.15, fc=C['ox'], ec='k', lw=0.5))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF + 0.15), w, 0.4, fc=C['poly'],
                           ec='k', lw=0.5))


# substrate contact, NMOS, PMOS, well contact
diff(0.5, 1.0, 'p')
diff(2.3, 1.2, 'n')
gate(3.6, 0.8)
diff(4.5, 1.2, 'n')
diff(7.8, 1.2, 'p')
gate(9.1, 0.8)
diff(10.0, 1.2, 'p')
diff(12.0, 1.0, 'n')

labels = [(1.0, '$V_\\mathrm{SS}$\n(sub)'), (2.9, 'S'), (4.0, 'G'),
          (5.1, 'D'), (8.4, 'D'), (9.5, 'G'), (10.6, 'S'),
          (12.5, '$V_\\mathrm{DD}$\n(well)')]
for x, t in labels:
    # gate leads end on top of the poly, all others on the diffusion surface
    y_end = SURF + 0.55 if t == 'G' else SURF
    ax.annotate(t, xy=(x, y_end), xytext=(x, SURF + 1.3),
                fontsize=9, ha='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.8))

ax.text(4.0, -0.5, 'NMOS', ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(9.5, -0.5, 'PMOS', ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 14.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.9, 5.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
